name: cyphra-monorepo
description: Cyphra - Privacy-First Payment Application Built on Midnight

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cyphra/shared run build && pnpm --filter @cyphra/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @cyphra/backend run build && pnpm --filter @cyphra/frontend run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @cyphra/shared run test && pnpm --filter @cyphra/contracts run test && pnpm --filter @cyphra/backend run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cyphra/shared run build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
